scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && node scripts/report.mjs
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.audit: npm --prefix backend audit --audit-level=critical && npm --prefix frontend audit --audit-level=critical
scripts.ci: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run check:architecture && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run audit && npm run build
